entry.summary: Visa-free short stays as part of the Schengen area.
entry.max_stay: 90 days in any 180-day period across the Schengen area
entry.pre_arrival: None today. ETIAS is on the watch list.
entry.other: Visa questions go to the Finnish Immigration Service. Schengen Entry/Exit System: fingerprints and photo at the border on first entry (free, nothing to do beforehand). Get an entry stamp where one is still given, and carry your passport across internal borders.

consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Helsinki; Australian Embassy, Stockholm
consular.notes: Australia has a consulate in Finland, headed by an Honorary Consul. It provides limited consular assistance. The consulate can't provide visa or immigration services or issue passports. You can get full consular assistance from the Australian Embassy in Stockholm, Sweden.

sources.supports: the Australian offices that give consular help

tourism.detail: Visa-free short stays as part of the Schengen area.

meetings.detail: Business meetings are covered, without being employed in the country.

conference.detail: Business travel, including conferences, is covered.

unpaid-speaking.detail: Unpaid speaking during a business visit is generally covered; the paid-activity exclusion is read narrowly.
unpaid-speaking.next: If unsure, ask Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.

paid-speaking.detail: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.
paid-speaking.next: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.

remote-work.detail: Remote work for an employer outside the EU isn't addressed in the EU guidance read.
remote-work.next: Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.

entrepreneur.detail: Exploring and meeting fit a business visit; running a business needs national permission.
entrepreneur.next: Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.

trade.detail: Business visits are covered; selling or delivering services may be paid activity.
trade.next: Keep the trip to meetings and negotiation.

artist.detail: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.
artist.next: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.

mixed-mission.detail: The visa-free stay covers the business and tourism parts; any paid part needs national permission.
mixed-mission.next: Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.

filming.route: Visa-free Schengen short stay (journalistic or media purposes)
filming.detail: Journalistic or media purposes are listed among visa-free purposes; paid production work and location permits are national matters.
filming.next: Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla about filming, and the local authority about locations.

research.route: Visa-free Schengen short stay (short-term study or training)
research.detail: Short-term study and training are covered; paid research at an institution is paid activity.
research.next: Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla if the host pays you.

volunteering.detail: Volunteering isn't addressed in the EU guidance read.
volunteering.next: Ask the Embassy of Finland, Yarralumla.
